name: Amazon Rainforest Trek
shortDescription: Trek deep into the Amazon canopy, spot wildlife at dawn, and sleep in riverside eco-lodges.
description: Journey into one of the most biodiverse places on Earth. This 7-day expedition combines guided jungle treks, canoe trips along tributary rivers, and nights at community-run eco-lodges. Expect close encounters with monkeys, macaws, and — if you're lucky — a jaguar print in the mud.
highlights: Guided night walk to spot nocturnal wildlife
Visit to a local indigenous community
All meals and eco-lodge accommodation included

name: Patagonia Glacier Expedition
shortDescription: Hike past towering granite peaks and calving glaciers in one of the world's last great wildernesses.
description: Ten days through the dramatic landscapes of Torres del Paine and the Southern Patagonian Ice Field. Daily hikes range from moderate valley walks to a full-day trek to the base of the towers, with small-group camping and refugio stays along the way.
highlights: Full-day hike to the base of the Torres del Paine towers

name: Sahara Desert Safari
shortDescription: Ride camels into the dunes, camp under the stars, and explore Berber villages along the way.
description: A five-day journey from the Atlas Mountains into the Erg Chebbi dunes. Travel by camel and 4x4, camp in a traditional desert camp with local music around the fire, and visit Berber villages that have called the desert home for generations.
highlights: Camel trek into the Erg Chebbi dunes at sunset
Overnight desert camp with traditional music
